findings.title: Launch template EBS volumes unencrypted
findings.description: A block_device_mappings entry in an aws_launch_template whose ebs map has encrypted = false leaves the volume readable at rest. (Known false only; absent follows the provider default.)
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: Launch template does not update its default version
findings.description: Without update_default_version = true, new template versions never become the default, so instances and auto scaling groups silently keep launching from a stale version that may miss security fixes.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Launch template without ebs_optimized declared
findings.description: ebs_optimized is absent from the launch template, so the provider default (false) applies to every instance launched from it: no dedicated EBS bandwidth. Declare ebs_optimized = true for EBS-backed workloads.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
